  • Method Details

    • region

      public HudNotification.Builder region(InsideRegion region)
      Where it pops up: an InsideRegion spot of the game window, 4px in from the edges it touches (default TOP_CENTER). Resolved by the one resolver the HUD panels use, RegionMath.resolveInside(InsideRegion, int, int, int, int, int, RegionMath.Insets).

    • offset

      public HudNotification.Builder offset(int dx, int dy)
      A pixel nudge after placement (default 0, 6: 10px below the top edge). Migrating from .anchor(MKHudAnchor.X, dx, dy): see HudPanel.Builder.offset(int, int).
